source_caption_text:
2009 Wiz was different 😤🔥

If there’s one song that instantly brings you back to the blog era, it’s Wiz Khalifa’s “This Plane.” Released in 2009, the track captured that early internet rap era when artists were building their own fanbases through blogs, mixtapes and word of mouth.

Wiz was still coming up out of Pittsburgh at the time, and “This Plane” had that laid-back sound that made his music so easy to get hooked on. The production, the hook and Wiz’s delivery all came together in a way that felt completely different from what was dominating radio.

Looking back, “This Plane” feels like a snapshot of Wiz’s early run before Kush & Orange Juice, “Black and Yellow” and the mainstream success that followed. It’s one of those songs that immediately takes you back to the blog era.
